propositions: The per-criterion fan-out recovery (one isolated evidence run per criterion) is replaced with batched incremental verification that records criterion verdicts to a run-scoped bank at the CompletionAgentStep seam, resuming with only unverified criteria in successor runs.

Criterion IDs are deterministically minted once at run start as c<two-digit index>-<sha256 hash[:8]> and used to key the bank, deduplicate criteria across primary and successor runs, and enable order-insensitive coverage validation.

The primary run receives a record_criterion_verdict tool instructed to bank each criterion verdict incrementally (provisional and revisable) as evidence becomes sufficient, with evidence capped at 3000 chars per entry and a truncated flag for audit trail.

On primary typed failure (LLMBudgetExhausted, RunawayToolLoop, token exhaustion), batched successor runs execute over the unverified remainder under a request budget pool denominated as global_pool = completion_recovery_pool_multiplier × ceil(verify_step_floor(c) / 2), with per-run allocation floor(pool_remaining / runs_remaining) and batch-size-aware no-launch shrinking.

The primary step floor is replaced with verify_step_floor(c) = clamp(completion_verify_steps_per_criterion × c, completion_verify_step_floor_min, 480) to scale linearly with criteria count and prevent manufacturing exhaustion via surplus budget; the old flat 480 clamp is retained and min-only so explicit REBAR_LLM_MAX_STEPS still wins.

The finalizer always emits a full-coverage verdict (verified criteria from banked evidence, unverified as met=false placeholders) when any verdicts are banked, with a deterministic no-LLM fallback that sets certifiable=false and finalizer=deterministic_fallback if the LLM finalizer fails twice, closing the verdict-less trap.
